title: The Altar of Hands
text: A stone table in the dark, set with hands the way another table would be set with plates. Some are wax, some are bone, and one is still warm. In the middle of the stone is a hollow worn smooth, shaped for exactly one more.

options.label: The weakest hand is laid in the hollow.

outcomes.text: The stone closes over the wrist and lets go. The hand that comes back is not quite theirs, and it is better.
The stone closes, and keeps what it took.
Nothing happens. That is somehow worse.

options.label: Leave the hands to their table.

outcomes.text: You go on, and nobody looks at their own hands for a while.
